lines.text: Spill the tea about the school trip!

data.define: To share juicy news about other people.

example.text: Spill the tea about the school trip!

misuse.text: Don't ask your teacher to 'spill the tea'.

publish.title: What does "spill the tea" mean?
publish.value: Spill the tea = Tell me the gossip. Example: "Spill the tea about the school trip!" (very casual English, US).
